people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: She went out, and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
translations.bsb: Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?” And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
translations.kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
translations.asv: And she went out, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptizer.
